breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly specified `The transport model is Sutherland.` This resolves the inconsistency, as a diffusion flame requires a model that accounts for viscous/diffusive transport, which Sutherland does. The agent avoided the user's incorrect instruction to use an inviscid (zero viscosity) model.
